Lina (PM): Quick thread: Sales pushed for a 'locked model' option so large deals don't get surprised by model swaps. Need a roadmap decision today.
Sam (Sales): Customer A & B both asked for 4-9 month locks. They care about API stability more than bleeding-edge perf.
Priya (Solutions): Proposal: make a Pin resource with TTL, health checks, and pre-migration notifications. Customers opt-in per contract.
Marco (Eng): Implementation constraints: long pins mean we must run nightly regression probes and add a fast unpin path. Also need canary cadence: 10% -> 25% -> full over 72h if rolling forward.
Lina (PM): Risk controls: default max TTL 6mo, >6mo needs VP signoff; automatic alerts 30/7 days before expiry; emergency unpin API for security/bugfix events.
ops-bot: nightly-pin-prober job scheduled -> will post anomalies to #eng-oncall.
Sam (Sales): Legal will want wording about liability and deprecated model support. I'll loop them in.
Marco (Eng): Action: I'll draft a short RFC for the Pin resource and nightly probe by EOD.
Lina (PM): Thanks—I'll add this to roadmap as 'Pinning pilot' for Q3 and collect initial customers.
